name: Brian
source:
Brian at first glance seems to be the perfect gentleman. That is, until the heroine happens upon Brian being coldly dumped by his date due to his ridiculous ideas of romance. He needs to make it up to the poor woman he disappointed, but how can he show how truly sorry he is if getting down on his knees and begging isn't a good idea?!

Luckily, the heroine has the right solution for him.

[From [url=http://somethingventuredgames.tumblr.com/post/153415095402/more-fools-helper-is-a-slice-of-life]Something Ventured Games[/url]]
